text:
Maria C (CS): FYI customer acme-enterprise complaining about 403s when calling embeddings and rerank APIs after onboarding. Started ~10:14 PDT.
Ben E (Eng): Do we have error payloads? 403 with message?
Maria C (CS): Pasted from their logs:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "insufficient_scope",
  "message": "Token missing required scopes: inference.embeddings.write, inference.rerank",
  "code": 403
}
```

They say the key was provisioned via our SSO onboarding flow.
Oliver (Oncall): Can you repro with their key? If not, ask them to curl a minimal call and paste headers.
Maria C (CS): I have a sanitized curl they ran:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-enterprise-XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

Response was the 403 above.
Ben E (Eng): Checked our logs for that key id: shows token_type=service_account, created by onboarding-service, template=legacy_onboard_v1. Scopes list in DB: ["inference.generate"] only. So embeddings & rerank were never granted.
Sofia (PM): Did onboarding change recently? We rolled a template tweak last month.
Ben E (Eng): Right — onboarding-service template v2 added embeddings for self-serve accounts but enterprise SSO still using legacy_onboard_v1 due to a feature flag. Looks like the entitlement mapping for SSO service accounts wasn't updated.
Maria C (CS): Customer is blocked: they use embeddings for semantic search in prod. They've opened CS ticket CS-2145 and asked for ETA.
SupportBot: Created internal ticket ENG-5321 and added "severity:high". Pinged eng oncall.
Oliver (Oncall): Immediate mitigation: 1) Ask customer to rotate key via Console -> API Keys -> Create key (select scopes: generate, embeddings, rerank). 2) For SSO-provisioned keys we can issue a temporary scopped key from support if customer can't rotate quickly.
Ben E (Eng): I'll add a CLI helper to create a scopped key for orgs until patch is deployed.

Quick repro steps for eng:
- Use booking: `select org acme-enterprise`
- Run: `redwood keys create --org acme-enterprise --scopes inference.generate,inference.embeddings,inference.rerank --label "temp-cs-issue-1775012345"`
- Validate with:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <new-key>" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Expected: 200 w/ embedding vector.

Root cause: onboarding-service uses legacy template for SSO orgs; template omitted embeddings/rerank scopes. Change record: onboarding-service PR #1483 rolled out Feb 2025 but flag not flipped for enterprise path.
Action items:
- Ben E (Eng): Patch onboarding-service template mapping and add unit test (ENG-5321) — due EOD.
- Oliver (Oncall): Provide customer with temp key and confirm workaround — in progress.
- Maria C (CS): Update CS ticket CS-2145 with mitigation steps + ask customer to rotate key — done.
- Sofia (PM): Schedule follow-up with PM and infra to audit templates across org types.

Maria C (CS): Customer accepted temporary key, verified embeddings call works (:thumbsup:). Will keep open until onboarding patch verified in staging.
Ben E (Eng): I'll push a hotfix to staging now, will notify when rolled.
Oliver (Oncall): Add postmortem note to #postmortems once resolved. Also check other SSO orgs for similar keys.
SupportBot: ENG-5321 created, linked to CS-2145, priority P1.
Sofia (PM): Nice catch. Let's also add an integration test in e2e onboarding harness to check scopes.
Ben E (Eng): Agreed. I'll attach logs and diffs to ENG-5321.

(edited) Maria C (CS): Final update — hotfix merged to prod at 22:43 UTC; we've audited 12 SSO orgs, 2 had missing scopes and were contacted. Closing CS-2145 after customer confirms tomorrow.
